quarterly_data.quarter: Delton Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product qualifications (annual report, 2025): in general-purpose servers the company completed transfer-to-volume capability for the PCIe 6.0 platform; in AI servers it completed process-capability certification of PCIe switch boards (30L+), UBB/IO boards (28L-46L), OAM boards (18L+, 2-step to 8-step HDI), GPU motherboards (24L 6-step HDI) and mid-plane backplanes (N+M / N+N); in data-center switches it reached volume production of 400G and 800G switch boards. Process breakthroughs included 6mm thick-board drilling, 30:1 aspect-ratio plating and back-drill alignment D+4 with stub control. It also pushed certification with core computing customers ahead of volume-order conversion.
quarterly_data.figure: 400G and 800G switch boards in volume production; PCIe 6.0 platform volume-capable

quarterly_data.quarter: Delton Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): 2025 R&D spending RMB 279,792,960.97 (+56.14%), 5.10% of revenue; 530 R&D staff (+35.55%). Completed projects: high-step HDI accelerated server card boards for AI and large-BGA server motherboards for HPC (target: stable volume production). In research: AI high-speed switch backplanes, multi-step HDI for GPU accelerator cards (OAM) aimed at stable OAM volume production meeting leading GPU makers' technical requirements, PAM4 signal-link simulation, 5% impedance control, deep micro-via plating and large-BGA stepped gold-finger PCBs for AI servers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Delton Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity projects (annual report): the Thailand plant started production in June 2025 and reached monthly profitability in December; it completed core-customer audits as planned and the company calls it a second growth engine for computing-product sales. The Thailand subsidiary had 2025 revenue RMB 160,659,402.09 and a net loss of RMB 57,112,785.14. Thailand plant phase I was at 97.94% project progress at year-end with RMB 888,850,029.90 invested cumulatively (RMB 240,549,468.06 in 2025); the Yunqing Smart Manufacturing Base project in Guangzhou was at 2.10% progress with RMB 53,764,008.56 invested; the Dongguan smart automated CNC plant and electronics manufacturing services project (budget RMB 453,215,694.00) was 84.91% complete. 2025 investment totalled RMB 3,078,100,397.53 (-12.03%).
quarterly_data.figure: Thailand phase I 97.94% progress (RMB 888,850,029.90 invested); Yunqing base 2.10% progress

quarterly_data.quarter: Delton Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 plan (annual report): the company expects 2026 to show structural undersupply of high-end capacity and persistently tight supply of key materials and equipment, with leading customers concentrating orders on strategic partners. Its plan: speed up retrofits at the Guangzhou and Huangshi bases to maximise capacity; start phase II investment planning and construction in Thailand after phase I reaches full production; bring the Guangzhou Yunqing Smart Manufacturing project to production run-through by end-2026 to take high-end products in 2027; move core suppliers to capacity binding and joint forecasting; and pre-research new materials and processes for 224G and higher signal rates. R&D and product development will focus on PCIe 6.0/7.0/8.0 servers, AI servers, high-step HDI, 112G/224G/448G switches and optical modules, and on growing Thailand revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: Yunqing production run-through targeted for end-2026
